content.title: Content
content.intro: Plan, prepare and follow your Instagram posts and stories.
content.notFound: This content could not be found.

generation.slow: This is taking longer than expected. You can also write the text yourself instead of waiting.
generation.failed: The draft could not be prepared automatically. You can write the text yourself.
generation.hint: The text appears by itself when it is ready. What you type meanwhile is kept.

editor.overlayNote: On a story the text has to be on the image: these suggestions are for you to put on the picture, they are not published separately.
editor.conflict: Someone else changed this while you were editing. The latest version has been loaded; what you typed is still there, review it and save again.
editor.editVoidsApproval: This content was sent for approval or scheduled. If you edit it, the approval is voided and it goes back to a draft.
editor.readOnly: This content can no longer be changed.

issues.label: Text check
issues.blockingHint: These must be fixed before it can be sent for publishing.
issues.blocking: “{{text}}” is not a verified fact. Correct the value or verify it in your business information.
issues.PLACEHOLDER_UNRENDERED: The placeholder “{{text}}” could not be filled in. Replace it with a verified fact or delete it.
issues.CLAIM_UNBACKED: The claim “{{text}}” is not backed by a verified fact. Remove it or verify the information.
issues.stale: A fact changed since this was checked. The text is checked again when you save.

checks.MEDIA_NOT_READY: The image is not ready yet.
checks.CAPTION_TOO_LONG: The caption is too long ({{length}} / {{max}} characters).
checks.CAPTION_NOT_ALLOWED: A story has no caption. Put the text on the image.
checks.ASPECT_RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE: The image ratio does not suit a post (it must be between 4:5 and 1.91:1).
checks.CLAIM_VALIDATION_FAILED: The text contains information that is not verified.
checks.ACCOUNT_NOT_CONNECTED: There is no connected Instagram account.
checks.CAPABILITY_MISSING: The connected account cannot publish this kind of content.
checks.STORY_ASPECT_NOT_9_16: The image is not 9:16 ({{width}}×{{height}}). It may be cropped or leave gaps at the edges on a story.
checks.OVERLAY_TOO_LONG: This suggestion is long: up to 3 lines of 40 characters stay readable.
checks.SCHEDULE_IN_PAST: The chosen time has already passed. Pick a later time.
checks.SCHEDULE_TOO_FAR: A post can be scheduled at most 60 days ahead.
checks.SCHEDULE_TIME_NONEXISTENT: There is no {{local_time}} on {{local_date}} in {{timezoneLabel}} (the clocks skip that hour). Choose another time.
checks.SCHEDULE_TOO_SOON_FOR_APPROVAL: Someone has to approve this before it is published. Choose a time at least {{minutes}} minutes from now.
checks.PUBLISH_QUOTA_FORECAST_EXCEEDED: Too many posts are already scheduled around this time. Choose another time.
checks.TEMPLATE_IMAGE_STALE: The image shows an old value ({{keys}}). Re-render it with the current value.
checks.CAROUSEL_MIXED_ASPECT_RATIO: Images {{positions}} have a different aspect ratio from image 1.
checks.REEL_DURATION_OUT_OF_RANGE: The reel video must be between 3 seconds and 15 minutes.
checks.REEL_COVER_OFFSET_INVALID: The selected cover frame position is outside the video duration.
checks.REEL_COVER_TOO_LARGE: The cover image must be at most 8 MB.
checks.REEL_ASPECT_NOT_9_16: The video is not 9:16; Instagram may crop it or add blank bars.
checks.REEL_RESOLUTION_BELOW_RECOMMENDED: The video width is below the recommended 540 pixels.
checks.REEL_EDIT_LIST_PRESENT: This video contains an edit list; live compatibility with Instagram is not yet verified.

EMPTY_FILE.next: Choose a video and upload it again.

NOT_A_VIDEO.what: This file is not a video.
NOT_A_VIDEO.next: Choose an MP4 or MOV video.

UNSUPPORTED_CONTAINER.what: This video container is not supported.

CORRUPT_VIDEO.what: The video could not be read.
CORRUPT_VIDEO.next: Export the original video again and retry.

NO_VIDEO_STREAM.what: This file has no video track.
NO_VIDEO_STREAM.next: Choose a file with one video track.

MULTIPLE_VIDEO_STREAMS.what: This file has multiple video tracks.
MULTIPLE_VIDEO_STREAMS.next: Export a file with one video track.

UNSUPPORTED_VIDEO_CODEC.what: The video codec is not supported.
UNSUPPORTED_VIDEO_CODEC.next: Export H.264 or HEVC video in MP4 or MOV.

UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_CODEC.what: The audio codec is not supported.
UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_CODEC.next: Export with AAC audio or without audio.

UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE.what: The audio sample rate exceeds 48 kHz or is unknown.
UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_SAMPLE_RATE.next: Export AAC audio at 48 kHz or lower.

UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_CHANNELS.what: The audio must be mono or stereo.
UNSUPPORTED_AUDIO_CHANNELS.next: Export AAC audio with one or two channels.

UNSUPPORTED_PIXEL_FORMAT.what: The video must use 4:2:0 colour sampling.
UNSUPPORTED_PIXEL_FORMAT.next: Export H.264 or HEVC with 4:2:0 colour sampling.

DURATION_UNKNOWN.what: The video duration could not be determined.
DURATION_UNKNOWN.next: Export the video again and retry.

DURATION_TOO_SHORT.what: The video is shorter than 3 seconds.
DURATION_TOO_SHORT.next: Choose a video lasting at least 3 seconds.

DURATION_TOO_LONG.what: The video is longer than 15 minutes.

FRAME_RATE_OUT_OF_RANGE.what: The frame rate must be between 23 and 60 FPS.

WIDTH_TOO_LARGE.what: The displayed video width exceeds 1920 pixels.
WIDTH_TOO_LARGE.next: Export with a displayed width of at most 1920 pixels.

RESOLUTION_TOO_LOW.what: The video dimensions are too small.
RESOLUTION_TOO_LOW.next: Use a video at least 64 pixels wide and high.

ASPECT_RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE.what: The video aspect ratio is not supported.
ASPECT_RATIO_OUT_OF_RANGE.next: Use a width-to-height ratio between 0.1 and 10; 9:16 is recommended.

MOOV_NOT_AT_FRONT.what: The video is not optimized for streaming.
MOOV_NOT_AT_FRONT.next: Export with “Fast Start” or “optimize for web” enabled.

EDIT_LIST_PRESENT.what: The video contains an edit list.
EDIT_LIST_PRESENT.next: Compatibility with Instagram has not been verified live.

ASPECT_NOT_9_16.what: The video is not in the recommended 9:16 format.
ASPECT_NOT_9_16.next: Instagram may crop the video or add blank space.

RESOLUTION_BELOW_RECOMMENDED.what: The video is below the recommended 540-pixel width.
RESOLUTION_BELOW_RECOMMENDED.next: A higher-resolution original may look better.

media.label: Image
media.feedHint: Add a portrait or square image for the post (between 4:5 and 1.91:1).
media.storyHint: Add a 9:16 image for the story. On Instagram the story text has to be on the image.
media.previewFailed: The image could not be shown.
media.deleted: The image was deleted because its retention period ended.
media.tooLarge: This image is too large (limit {{limit}}). Choose a smaller one.

reason.EMPTY_FILE: The file is empty. Choose another image.
reason.NOT_AN_IMAGE: This file is not a supported image. Upload a JPEG or PNG.
reason.CORRUPT_IMAGE: The image file looks damaged. Choose another image.
reason.TOO_MANY_PIXELS: The image resolution is too high. Choose a smaller image.

actions.cancelAsk: Cancel this item? Its scheduled publication is cancelled too.
actions.waitGeneration: It cannot be scheduled while the text is being prepared.
actions.fromTemplate: Make an image from a template

generate.title: New content
generate.objectiveLabel: What do you want to share?
generate.objectiveHint: E.g. “A story for the trial class”. Prices, hours and similar details come only from your verified information.
generate.accountHint: When you schedule, the content is set up to be published on this account.
generate.accountNone: No Instagram account is connected. You can prepare the draft; connect the account before scheduling.
generate.runningHint: This can take a few seconds. If you would rather not wait, open the draft now and write the text yourself.
generate.slow: It is taking longer than expected. Open the draft and write the text yourself.
generate.failedTitle: The draft could not be prepared automatically.
generate.failedHint: A blank draft was created. You can write the text yourself.
generate.titleHint: A name only you will see. You add the text and the image in the draft.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.timezoneHint: The time you enter is in {{zone}}.
schedule.overlayNote: This text is not published separately with the story; it has to be on the image.
schedule.whenNow: Now: queued for publishing as soon as it is approved
schedule.staffNote: This is published after an owner or manager approves it. If it is not approved by the chosen time it expires and goes back to a draft.
schedule.approverNote: When you approve, the item is scheduled. It reads “Scheduled” until Instagram confirms it was published.
schedule.nowNote: The item is queued for publishing right away. It does not read “Published” until that is confirmed.
schedule.reapproveNote: It is approved again with the text unchanged. Everything is checked again: if the text still has a value that is not verified, such as an old price, edit it first.

approval.heading: What this approval will publish
approval.caption: Caption
approval.overlayNote: Not published separately with a story; it has to be on the image.
approval.stale: This content changed after approval was requested (now version {{current}}, approval covers version {{approved}}). This approval no longer applies; the content has to be sent for approval again.
approval.loadFailed: The content could not be loaded.

detail.pending: Waiting for approval: it is scheduled once an owner or manager approves. If it is not approved by {{time}} it expires and goes back to a draft.
detail.processing: Instagram is processing this reel video. It will be published automatically when ready.
detail.rejectedNext: You can edit it and send it again.

draftHold.FACT_CHANGED: Business information it uses changed, so the item sent for approval was returned to a draft. Review the text and send it again.
draftHold.APPROVAL_EXPIRED: The approval expired, so it went back to a draft. Pick a new time and send it again.

detail.cancelled: This item was cancelled and will not be published.
detail.publishing: Publishing. The status updates when Instagram confirms it.

failure.title: What happened?
failure.retryAt: Will be tried again at {{time}} ({{attempts}} attempts so far)
failure.retryAuto: It is retried automatically; you do not need to do anything.
failure.noRetry: It will not be retried automatically.

unknown.next: Open the post to see the details, then edit or schedule it again.

failure.exhausted: It could not be published after several attempts.

hold.title: On hold

FACT_CHANGED.what: It was put on hold because business information it uses has changed.
FACT_CHANGED.next: Review the text; if it is still right, approve it again as it is, otherwise edit it.

ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.what: It was put on hold because the Instagram account was not available.
ACCOUNT_UNAVAILABLE.next: Reconnect the account, then approve it again.

unknown.what: This item was put on hold.
unknown.next: Review the text, then approve it again or edit it.

hold.staffNote: An owner or manager has to approve it again. You can edit the text and send it for approval again.

composer.title: Start new content
composer.placeholder: E.g. a story for Saturday's trial class
composer.hint: Prices, hours and similar details come only from your verified information.
composer.noAccount: No Instagram account is connected yet; you can still prepare drafts.

tabHelp.drafts: Drafts and posts waiting for approval, most recently edited first.
tabHelp.scheduled: Approved and waiting for their time, earliest first.
tabHelp.problems: On hold, failed or rejected. Open one to see what to do next.

filters.label: Filter content
filters.noMatchHint: Try another word or show all formats.

capped.recent: Showing the {{count}} most recent. Older items are not listed here.
capped.earliest: Showing the first {{count}} scheduled items. Later ones are not listed here.

emptyHint.drafts: Describe a post or story above and the assistant prepares a draft, or start a blank one and write it yourself.
emptyHint.scheduled: Open a draft, add an image and choose a time. Approved posts wait here until they go out.
emptyHint.published: Posts and stories appear here once Instagram confirms they are live.
emptyHint.problems: Nothing is on hold, failed or rejected.

onboarding.title: Your content library is empty
onboarding.intro: This is how a post goes from an idea to Instagram.
onboarding.step1: The assistant drafts the text from your verified business information. You can also write it yourself.
onboarding.step2: Add an image, check the preview and choose a time. Nothing goes out without approval.
onboarding.step3: Published posts, and anything that needs attention, show up here.

agenda.emptyHint: When you schedule a draft, it appears here on its day.
agenda.capped: Only the first {{count}} scheduled items are loaded. Days after {{day}} may hold more.

template.title: Image from a template
template.intro: Pick a template. Prices and hours come from your verified business information; they are never typed in here.
template.noPrices: You have no verified prices yet. Verify a price in your business information first.
template.hoursMissing: Your opening hours are not verified yet. Verify them first.
template.headline: Headline
template.announcementHint: Do not type prices, times or phone numbers. Insert them as facts (a fact placeholder such as fact:pricing.monthly_membership in double braces); typed values are refused.
template.previewEmpty: Fill in the fields to see the preview.
template.previewFailed: The preview could not be prepared.
template.savedDraft: Saved as a draft. Nothing is published.

stale.title: This image shows an old value
stale.body: {{facts}} changed or is no longer verified since this image was made. Re-render it with the current value before it goes out.
stale.holdHint: Re-render the image first; the item then needs approval again.
stale.done: A new image was made. The item is a draft again and needs approval again before it can be scheduled.

carousel.captionHint: One caption for the whole carousel (up to 2,200 characters). Instagram has no per-image captions.
carousel.manualHint: Start a blank carousel and upload your images. AI and templates are unavailable for carousels.
carousel.cap: Maximum 10 images. Extra files were not uploaded.

reel.manualHint: Open a blank reel to upload your video and set its cover. AI generation and templates are not available for reels.
reel.hint: MP4 or MOV up to 300 MB, 3 seconds to 15 minutes.
reel.wrongFileType: Choose an MP4 or MOV video file.
reel.fileTooLarge: The video must be at most 300 MB.
reel.coverHint: Use a frame from the video or upload a JPEG cover image (up to 8 MB).
reel.coverWrongType: Choose a JPEG cover image (.jpg or .jpeg).
reel.coverTooLarge: The cover image must be at most 8 MB.
reel.shareToFeedHint: Show this reel in your main profile grid as well as the Reels tab.
reel.notFactChecked: Video and audio are not fact-checked automatically. Make sure prices, hours and claims in the video match your current business information.
reel.deleted: This video was deleted after publishing and is no longer stored.
reel.coverDeleted: The custom cover image was deleted after publishing.

tour.composerDesc: Describe an idea for the assistant, start a blank draft, or pick a ready-made template.
tour.viewsDesc: Switch between your status tabs and a calendar view of scheduled posts.
tour.tabsDesc: Follow drafts awaiting review, scheduled posts, published items, and anything needing a fix.
